linework.observation: Bold continuous contours keep the operator, console, log board and handsets readable; close to the canonical interior sample.

colour.observation: FAIL: saturated red light washes across most of the ceiling, consoles and floor, creating a neon cast outside the muted palette.

shading.observation: Broad illustrated shadows shape the console and coveralls; highlights remain drawn rather than photographic.

character_construction.observation: The bald protagonist has rounded head, nose, ears, brows and mouth; body proportions remain coherent.

backgrounds.observation: Dense sonar room with consoles, a watch board and narrow passage; believable enclosed work area.

finish.observation: Clean contours and clear focal hierarchy, with no apparent glitches.

identity.observation: Bald face and navy coveralls match the protagonist and level-one costume.

content.observation: Sonar station, handset and log fit the scene; no outside view or unrelated objects.

composition.observation: Wide full-body framing keeps the protagonist and major station equipment in frame with headroom.

regions.people_faces: One bald protagonist at the console with a focused, subdued expression.
regions.clothing: Dark navy coveralls; no added costume or identity drift.
regions.foreground_props: Handset, clipboard and console controls support the watch task.
regions.architecture: Submarine control space with enclosed passage, watch board and equipment banks.
regions.distance: Equipment rows recede to a dark passage; readable scene depth.
regions.lighting: Red practical lamps dominate the entire scene with excessive saturation; needs localized dim indicators.

correction: Keep the same sonar watch scene and framing. Reduce the red lighting to a few small dim status indicators, with most illumination in restrained warm cream and charcoal tones. Preserve the bald protagonist, navy coveralls, clean outlined equipment and cel shading; avoid global red glow.
